components.css: .ds-btn { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 20px; min-height: 48px; padding: 13px 18px; border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: var(--radius, 6px); font-family: var(--font-sans); font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.01em; text-decoration: none; transition: background 150ms, border-color 150ms, transform 150ms, box-shadow 150ms; } .ds-btn-primary { background: var(--primary); border-color: var(--primary); color: var(--on-primary); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: var(--primary-hover); transform: translateY(-2px); box-shadow: 0 3px 8px var(--shadow-color); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: none; } .ds-btn:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--focus-ring); outline-offset: 5px; }

components.css: .ds-card { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 14px; max-width: 360px; padding: 26px; border: 1px solid var(--border); background: var(--surface); color: var(--foreground); text-decoration: none; box-shadow: 0 2px 10px var(--shadow-color); transition: border-color 180ms, transform 180ms; } .ds-card:hover { border-color: var(--primary); transform: translateY(-4px); } .ds-card:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--focus-ring); outline-offset: 5px; } .ds-card h3 { margin: 20px 0 0; font-size: 1.5rem; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: -0.015em; } .ds-card p { margin: 0; color: var(--muted-foreground); font-size: 0.875rem; line-height: 1.7; } .ds-card-kicker { color: var(--muted-foreground); font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 500; } .ds-card-tag { align-self: flex-start; padding: 5px 8px; border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 3px; color: var(--muted-foreground); font-size: 0.75rem; }

components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; gap: 24px; } .ds-nav a { position: relative; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; min-height: 44px; color: var(--muted-foreground); font-family: var(--font-sans); font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; text-decoration: none; } .ds-nav a::after { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 0; right: 0; bottom: 3px; height: 2px; background: var(--primary); opacity: 0; transition: opacity 150ms; } .ds-nav a:hover, .ds-nav a[aria-current] { color: var(--accent-foreground); } .ds-nav a:hover::after, .ds-nav a[aria-current]::after { opacity: 1; } .ds-nav a:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--focus-ring); outline-offset: 5px; }

narrative.overview:
The site is a dark, editorial workspace that belongs to one person. Near-black pages, white type and thin hairlines keep it calm. Neon green is the light on the desk: it marks actions, accent words and hover states, and almost nothing else. The details are an engineer's (numbered section labels, a typing terminal card, a section rail), but the voice and the imagery are human: a real portrait, a childhood pixel avatar, plain first-person copy and a smile demo that says hello.

The system is not being reinvented. Its palette, fonts and layouts are fixed by AGENTS.md and src/theme.css, and new work should feel like the same person made it. "More human" means warmer content and gentler moments inside this frame (photos, stories, who the work helped), never a new color or a softer theme.

Controls are precise and quiet. Surfaces separate by tone and hairlines, and cards and panels sit on a soft shadow so the page reads in layers.
keyCharacteristics: Neon Dark by default; Neon Light only through the header toggle.
One sans family for everything readable; mono only where text is literally code.
Green used sparingly as the signal; blue reserved for focus.
Thin 1px hairlines, small 6px corners, generous whitespace.
Real photos and the pixel avatar carry the personality; decoration does not.
Every animation has a reduced-motion fallback.

rules.name: The Single Source Rule
rules.body: Every color value is authored once in src/theme.css. Components use semantic variables only: no hex, no fallbacks, no new colors. A theme change needs Nghia's explicit request.

rules.name: The Signal Rule
rules.body: Green marks what you can act on or what matters most in a block. If a screen is mostly green, it has lost its signal.

rules.name: The Retired Colors Rule
rules.body: Pink #FF0099, Warm Ivory, Ember Dark and RawBlock are gone and stay gone.

rules.name: The Two Fonts Rule
rules.body: Be Vietnam Pro for everything a person reads; JetBrains Mono only for things that are code. Tags and labels are not code. (The .mono class name is historical; it now renders the sans.)

rules.name: The Green Period Rule
rules.body: Page titles and key headings end in a period colored with the accent.

rules.name: The Layered Sheets Rule
rules.body: Cards and panels sit on the resting shadow; hover adds lift and a green border, never a glow.

dos: Do use the semantic variables from src/theme.css for every color, in both modes.
Do keep green for actions, accent text and hover, and blue for focus.
Do check text contrast at 4.5:1 and indicators at 3:1 in Neon Dark and Neon Light.
Do bring personality through real content: photos, the pixel avatar, stories about who the work helped, plain first-person copy.
Do give every motion a reduced-motion fallback.
donts: Don't add, change or hardcode colors, or bring back pink, Warm Ivory, Ember Dark or RawBlock.
Don't switch themes from the OS preference or per page; Neon Dark opens every visit.
Don't use JetBrains Mono for tags, labels or decorative numbers.
Don't put white labels on green or mint fills.
Don't add glows, gradients or decorative illustrations to make the site feel friendlier.
Don't restore the Home scroll color shift or Mini Nghia without Nghia asking.
